description: Rotate SSL certificate on production with SLO burn active

playbook.content:
- name: Rotate SSL cert
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: new_cert.pem
        dest: /etc/ssl/certs/app.pem
    - ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded

tier_rationale: SLO burn rate 65% — cert rotation during active incident requires quorum
